results.title: Brazilian Sketches
results.text: Brazilian Sketches is an album by British saxophonist Jim Tomlinson that was released in 2003. The album features Stacey Kent on vocals. The album contains cover versions of songs by Antonio Carlos Jobim, Vinícius de Moraes, Marcos Valle, and Luiz Bonfá.

results.title: Só no Forévis
results.text: Só no Forevis is the fifth album of the Brazilian rock band Raimundos, launched in 1999. Its title is a tribute to the Brazilian humorist Mussum from Os Trapalhões, died in 1994. It is the Raimundos' most sold CD, with eight hundred and fifty thousand copies. This album is the last studio work of the vocalist Rodolfo with Raimundos.

results.title: Lambada (song)
results.text: "Lambada", also known as "Chorando Se Foi (Lambada)" or "Llorando se fue (Lambada)", is a song recorded by French pop group Kaoma. It features guest vocals by Brazilian vocalist Loalwa Braz. It was released as the first single from Kaoma's debut album "Worldbeat". The video, filmed on Cocos beach in the city of Trancoso, in the state of Bahia, Brazil, features the Brazilian child duo Chico & Roberta.

results.title: Uncle Kent
results.text: Uncle Kent is a 2011 American film written by Kent Osborne and co-written and directed and Joe Swanberg. The film stars Kent Osborne in the titular role of Kent, and Jennifer Prediger, Josephine Decker, Kevin Bewersdof, and Swanberg. The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival and was released through video on demand, the same day on January 21, 2011.
